protocol.rule: Rerank all currently nominated cases by L12 raw logit, case_id tie break. No logit cutoff, score blending, candidate expansion or filtering. Healthcare merges its existing spelling-specific nominations by maximum logit. Chart uses original baseline hits and scores, never the reranked list.
protocol.gate: No loss of known direct top-ten cases; no new known irrelevant top-ten cases; at least one known irrelevant top-ten removal. Report replacements and rank movements separately; no threshold tuning.

limitations: Previously inspected partial labels; not independent validation or whole-result precision.
Aliases overlap; counts are query/case memberships, not independent cases.
Offline model timings are not deployment memory/latency measurements.
